purpose: Evaluate OCR and table extraction on one embedded inventory-grid screenshot in an attributed Commerce operating reference.
reference_method: The KETER item label and six visible values were transcribed from the rendered source page by one AI agent. This is one selected row, not a human-reviewed transcription or multi-reviewer gold standard.
limitations: This is a born-digital 2022 Sam's Club supplier guide with an embedded low-resolution UI screenshot, not a physical scan.
The selected region is rasterized before processing to force the production upload OCR path; results do not measure OCR on the PDF's native text layer.
The guide applies only to the named Sam's Club supplier workflow and is not a Commerce Demo policy or data source.
Only one visible item row is labeled; a passing row score does not establish complete table extraction or general OCR accuracy.
